source.query: SELECT [D_City_SID], [WWI City ID], [City], [State Province], [Country], [Continent], [Sales Territory], [Region], [Subregion], [Latest Recorded Population], [Valid From], [Valid To], [Lineage Key] FROM [common].[D_City]

SELECT [D_Customer_SID], [WWI Customer ID], [Customer], [Bill To Customer], [Category], [Buying Group], [Primary Contact], [Postal Code], [Valid From], [Valid To], [Lineage Key] FROM [common].[D_Customer]

SELECT [Date], [Day Number], [Day], [Month], [Short Month], [Calendar Month Number], [Calendar Month Label], [Calendar Year], [Calendar Year Label], [Fiscal Month Number], [Fiscal Month Label], [Fiscal Year], [Fiscal Year Label], [ISO Week Number] FROM [common].[D_Date]
SELECT [D_Employee_SID], [WWI Employee ID], [Employee], [Preferred Name], [Is Salesperson], [Valid From], [Valid To], [Lineage Key] FROM [common].[D_Employee]
SELECT [D_PaymentMethod_SID], [WWI Payment Method ID], [Payment Method], [Valid From], [Valid To], [Lineage Key] FROM [common].[D_PaymentMethod]

SELECT [D_StockItem_SID], [WWI Stock Item ID], [Stock Item], [Color], [Selling Package], [Buying Package], [Brand], [Size], [Lead Time Days], [Quantity Per Outer], [Is Chiller Stock], [Barcode], [Tax Rate], [Unit Price], [Recommended Retail Price], [Typical Weight Per Unit], [Valid From], [Valid To], [Lineage Key] FROM [common].[D_StockItem]

SELECT [D_Supplier_SID], [WWI Supplier ID], [Supplier], [Category], [Primary Contact], [Supplier Reference], [Payment Days], [Postal Code], [Valid From], [Valid To], [Lineage Key] FROM [common].[D_Supplier]
SELECT [D_TransactionType_SID], [WWI Transaction Type ID], [Transaction Type], [Valid From], [Valid To], [Lineage Key] FROM [common].[D_TransactionType]

SELECT [Movement Key], [Date], [D_StockItem_SID], [D_Customer_SID], [D_Supplier_SID], [D_TransactionType_SID], [WWI Stock Item Transaction ID], [WWI Invoice ID], [WWI Purchase Order ID], [Quantity], [Lineage Key] FROM [delivery].[F_Movement]

SELECT [Purchase Key], [Date], [D_Supplier_SID], [D_StockItem_SID], [WWI Purchase Order ID], [Ordered Outers], [Ordered Quantity], [Received Outers], [Package], [Is Order Finalized], [Lineage Key] FROM [delivery].[F_Purchase]

SELECT [Stock Holding Key], [D_StockItem_SID], [Quantity On Hand], [Bin Location], [Last Stocktake Quantity], [Last Cost Price], [Reorder Level], [Target Stock Level], [Lineage Key] FROM [delivery].[F_StockHolding]

SELECT [Order Key], [D_City_SID], [D_Customer_SID], [D_StockItem_SID], [Order Date], [Picked Date], [Salesperson_D_Employee_SID], [Picker_D_Employee_SID], [WWI Order ID], [WWI Backorder ID], [Description], [Package], [Quantity], [Unit Price], [Tax Rate], [Total Excluding Tax], [Tax Amount], [Total Including Tax], [Lineage Key] FROM [finance].[F_Order]

SELECT [Sale Key], [D_City_SID], [D_Customer_SID], [BillTo_D_Customer_SID], [D_StockItem_SID], [Invoice Date], [Delivery Date], [D_Employee_SID], [WWI Invoice ID], [Description], [Package], [Quantity], [Unit Price], [Tax Rate], [Total Excluding Tax], [Tax Amount], [Profit], [Total Including Tax], [Total Dry Items], [Total Chiller Items], [Lineage Key] FROM [finance].[F_Sale]

SELECT [Transaction Key], [Date], [D_Customer_SID], [BillTo_D_Customer_SID], [D_Supplier_SID], [D_TransactionType_SID], [D_PaymentMethod_SID], [WWI Customer Transaction ID], [WWI Supplier Transaction ID], [WWI Invoice ID], [WWI Purchase Order ID], [Supplier Invoice Number], [Total Excluding Tax], [Tax Amount], [Total Including Tax], [Outstanding Balance], [Is Finalized], [Lineage Key] FROM [finance].[F_Transaction]
